questions.question: Last year, Ranjan's monthly salary was ₹34,500 and this year his monthly salary is ₹38,640. What is the percentage increase in Ranjan's monthly salary this year over his monthly salary last year?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Last year's monthly salary = ₹34,500

This year's monthly salary = ₹38,640

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Increase = (New Value - Old Value)/(Old Value) × 100

**Calculation:**

New Value = ₹38,640

Old Value = ₹34,500

Percentage Increase = (38,640 - 34,500)/(34,500) × 100

Percentage Increase = 4,140/34,500 × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = 0.12 × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = 12%

**The percentage increase in Ranjan's monthly salary this year over his monthly salary last year is 12%.**

Discount scheme (i): Two successive discounts of 25% and 5%

questions.question: Find the fourth proportional to 2, 6, 8.
questions.solution:

Third number (c) = 8

Fourth proportional (d) = (b × c) / a

**Calculation:**

Fourth proportional = 48 / 2

Fourth proportional = 24

questions.question: Arun and Bhaskar run a race of 3 km. First, Arun gives Bhaskar a head start of 400 m and beats him by 30 seconds. While coming back, Arun gives Bhaskar a lead of 2.5 minutes and gets beaten by 500 m. What is the difference between the times in minutes in which Arun and Bhaskar can run the race for one side separately?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let TA and TB be the times in minutes to run 3000 m.

Case 1: Arun runs 3000 m while Bhaskar runs 2600 m and loses by 0.5 min.

⇒ TA = (2600 ÷ 3000) × TB − 0.5 ⇒ TA = (13/15)TB − 0.5

Case 2: Bhaskar runs 3000 m while Arun runs 2500 m starting 2.5 min late.

⇒ TB = (2500 ÷ 3000) × TA + 2.5 ⇒ TB = (5/6)TA + 2.5

Substitute TB: TA = (13/15)((5/6)TA + 2.5) − 0.5 ⇒ (5/18)TA = 5/3 ⇒ TA = 6 min, TB = 7.5 min.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.5 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 3 km = 3000 m.

Case 1: Bhaskar head start = 400 m, Arun beats him by 30 s = 0.5 min.

Case 2: Bhaskar time lead = 2.5 min, Arun beaten by 500 m.

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 0 m 3000 m 
 Case 1: Arun (3000m) wins by 0.5 min 
 Bhaskar (2600m) starting at 400m 
 Case 2: Bhaskar (3000m) wins 
 Arun (2500m) starting 2.5 min late 
 

Let VA and VB be the speeds of Arun and Bhaskar in m/min.

⇒ Case 1: 3000 ÷ VA = (3000 − 400) ÷ VB − 0.5

⇒ 3000 ÷ VA = 2600 ÷ VB − 0.5 --- (1)

⇒ Case 2: (3000 − 500) ÷ VA = 3000 ÷ VB − 2.5

⇒ 2500 ÷ VA = 3000 ÷ VB − 2.5 --- (2)

⇒ From (1), 1/VA = (2600/VB − 0.5) ÷ 3000

⇒ Substitute in (2): 2500 × [(2600/VB − 0.5) ÷ 3000] = 3000/VB − 2.5

⇒ (5/6) × (2600/VB − 0.5) = 3000/VB − 2.5

⇒ 13000/(6VB) − 2.5/6 = 3000/VB − 2.5

⇒ 2.5 − 5/12 = 3000/VB − 6500/(3VB)

⇒ 25/12 = (9000 − 6500) ÷ (3VB) ⇒ 25/12 = 2500 ÷ (3VB)

⇒ 3VB = (2500 × 12) ÷ 25 ⇒ 3VB = 1200 ⇒ VB = 400 m/min

⇒ Time for Bhaskar (TB) = 3000 ÷ 400 = 7.5 min

⇒ Substitute VB in (1): 3000 ÷ VA = 2600 ÷ 400 − 0.5 = 6.5 − 0.5 = 6 min

⇒ Time for Arun (TA) = 6 min

⇒ Difference = 7.5 − 6 = 1.5 min

**∴ The correct answer is 1.5 min.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Head Start vs Time Lead

A head start of 'x' meters means the opponent starts 'x' meters ahead. A time lead of 't' minutes means the opponent starts 't' minutes earlier than the other person.

Beating by Distance vs Time

If A beats B by 'd' meters, B is 'd' meters behind when A finishes. If A beats B by 't' minutes, B takes 't' minutes more than A to cover the same distance.

Relative Speed in Races

In a linear race, if both run in the same direction, relative speed is the difference of their speeds: Vᵣₑₗ = |VA − VB|.

questions.question: 10 years ago, a man's age was 5 times of his son's age. 2 years hence, twice his age will be equal to 4 times the age of his son. What is the present age (in years) of the son?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio (Man : Son) 10 years ago = 5 : 1 (Difference = 4 units)

Ratio (Man : Son) 2 years hence = 4 : 2 = 2 : 1 (Difference = 1 unit)

Make difference equal: Multiply (2 : 1) by 4 ⇒ New Ratio = 8 : 4

Gap in Son's ratio units = 4 − 1 = 3 units. Total time gap = 10 + 2 = 12 years.

3 units = 12 years ⇒ 1 unit = 4 years.

Son's age 10 years ago = 1 unit = 4 years ⇒ Present age = 4 + 10 = 14 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 14 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let the present age of the man be M and the son be S.

10 years ago: (M − 10) = 5 × (S − 10)

2 years hence: 2 × (M + 2) = 4 × (S + 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43f90f63387b96769133d990bb29bf4f23b0137d5d491dae2d2e74cad6675d4f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ M − 10 = 5S − 50

⇒ M = 5S − 40 --- (Equation 1)

⇒ 2(M + 2) = 4(S + 2)

⇒ M + 2 = 2(S + 2)

⇒ M + 2 = 2S + 4

⇒ M = 2S + 2 --- (Equation 2)

⇒ 5S − 40 = 2S + 2

⇒ 3S = 42

⇒ S = 42 ÷ 3

⇒ S = 14 years

**∴ The correct answer is 14 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two people remains constant throughout their lives, regardless of how many years pass.

Sum of Ages Change

If the sum of ages of N people is X today, then after Y years, the new sum will be X + (N × Y).

Ratio Balancing Method

To solve age problems using ratios, always ensure the difference between the ratio parts of two individuals is made equal across different time periods.</p

questions.question: Find the area of a rhombus whose diagonals are of lengths 10 cm and 8.2 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of diagonal 1 (d₁) = 10 cm

Length of diagonal 2 (d₂) = 8.2 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of rhombus = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂

**Calculation:**

Area = (1/2) × 10 × 8.2

⇒ Area = 5 × 8.2

⇒ Area = 41 cm²

**The area of the rhombus is 41 cm².**

questions.question: A can complete a piece of work in 20 days and B can complete the same work in 10 days. With the help of C, working together they completed the work in 5 days. The number of days in which C alone can complete the work is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM of 20, 10, and 5 = 20 units.

Combined efficiency of A, B, and C = 20 ÷ 5 = 4 units/day.

Combined efficiency of A and B = (20 ÷ 20) + (20 ÷ 10) = 1 + 2 = 3 units/day.

Efficiency of C = 4 − 3 = 1 unit/day.

Time taken by C alone = 20 ÷ 1 = 20 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

questions.question: The radius of a sphere is increased by 25%. What is the increase per cent in surface area?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area of a sphere is proportional to the square of its radius (r²).

Net percentage change = x + y + (x × y)/100

Here x = 25 and y = 25.

Increase % = 25 + 25 + (25 × 25)/100

Increase % = 50 + 6.25 = 56.25%

**∴ The correct answer is 56.25%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: Increase in radius = 25%

Formula Used: Surface Area of a sphere = 4πr²

 
 
• 
 r = 4 units
 Initial Area ∝ 4²
 
 
• 
 r = 5 units
 New Area ∝ 5²
 Radius Ratio 4 : 5 (25% increase)

⇒ Let original radius r₁ = 4 units

⇒ New radius r₂ = 4 + (25% of 4) = 5 units

⇒ Original Surface Area A₁ = 4 × π × (4)² = 64π

⇒ New Surface Area A₂ = 4 × π × (5)² = 100π

⇒ Percentage Increase = [(A₂ − A₁) ÷ A₁] × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = [(100π − 64π) ÷ 64π] × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = (36 ÷ 64) × 100 = (9 ÷ 16) × 100 = 56.25%

**∴ The correct answer is 56.25%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume Percentage Change

Since Volume ∝ r³, if radius increases by 25% (ratio 4:5), the volume ratio becomes 4³:5³ = 64:125, resulting in a 95.31% increase.

General Successive Change Formula

For any two-dimensional measurement change (Area of circle, square, or sphere surface), total % change = x + y + (xy/100).

Sphere Properties

Surface Area = 4πr² and Volume = (4/3)πr³. For a hemisphere, Curved Surface Area = 2πr² and Total Surface Area = 3πr².</p

questions.question: If two numbers are each divided by the same divisor, then the remainders are 6 and 7, respectively. If the sum of the two numbers be divided by the same divisor, then the remainder is 5. The divisor is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Remainder when the first number is divided by the divisor = 6

Remainder when the second number is divided by the divisor = 7

Remainder when the sum of the two numbers is divided by the same divisor = 5

**Formula Used:**

If the remainders of two numbers when divided by the same divisor are r₁ and r₂, and the remainder when their sum is divided by the same divisor is r₃, then the divisor d can be found using:

r1 + r2 = r3 + kd

where k is an integer.

**Calculation:**

Given:

r₁ = 6

r₂ = 7

r₃ = 5

Using the formula:

6 + 7 = 5 + kd

⇒ 13 = 5 + kd

⇒ 13 - 5 = kd

⇒ 8 = kd

Since d must be a divisor of 8, the possible values for d are 1, 2, 4, and 8. However, the only option given that matches this is 8.

**The divisor is 8.**

questions.question: What is the value of (1)/(sin⁴(90^circ - 2alpha)) + (1)/(cos²(90^circ - 2alpha) - 1) ?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Put **α = 15°**, so **2α = 30°**.

Expression: 1/sin⁴(90°−30°) + 1/(cos²(90°−30°) − 1) = 1/sin⁴60° + 1/(cos²60° − 1).

⇒ 1/(√3/2)⁴ + 1/((1/2)² − 1) = 16/9 + 1/(1/4 − 1) = 16/9 − 4/3 = 4/9.

Check options: Option (4) sec²30° × tan²30° = (2/√3)² × (1/√3)² = 4/3 × 1/3 = 4/9.

**∴ The correct answer is sec² 2α tan² 2α.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d46ed134d6b92dc03d2d1f60ad6f3d2c3a6de81eb670865d74fc54b2482c06ce.png] 

**Given:** Expression = 1/sin⁴(90° − 2α) + 1/(cos²(90° − 2α) − 1)

**Formulas Used:** sin(90°−θ) = cosθ; cos(90°−θ) = sinθ; 1−sin²θ = cos²θ

⇒ Expression = 1/cos⁴ 2α + 1/(sin² 2α − 1)

⇒ Expression = 1/cos⁴ 2α − 1/(1 − sin² 2α)

⇒ Expression = 1/cos⁴ 2α − 1/cos² 2α

⇒ Expression = (1 − cos² 2α) / cos⁴ 2α

⇒ Expression = sin² 2α / cos⁴ 2α = (sin² 2α / cos² 2α) × (1 / cos² 2α)

⇒ Expression = tan² 2α × sec² 2α

**∴ The correct answer is sec² 2α tan² 2α.**

**__Additional Information__**

Complementary Angle Rules

Trigonometric ratios change to their co-functions when the angle is (90° − θ): sin ↔ cos, tan ↔ cot, sec ↔ cosec.

Pythagorean Identities

Fundamental identities include sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.</p

questions.question: The measures of the three angles of a triangle are such that the smallest angle measures 42º less than the greatest angle, while the measure of the remaining angle is 24º more than the measure of the smallest angle. Find the measure of the smallest angle of the triangle.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The smallest angle measures 42º less than the greatest angle.

The remaining angle is 24º more than the smallest angle.

**Formula Used:**

Sum of angles in a triangle = 180º

**Calculation:**

Let the smallest angle be x º.

Largest angle = x + 42 º

Remaining angle = x + 24° 

Sum of angles: x + (x + 42) + (x + 24) = 180 º

⇒ 3x + 66 = 180

⇒ 3x = 180 - 66

⇒ 3x = 114

⇒ x = 38

Smallest angle = x = 38°. 

**The measure of the smallest angle of the triangle is 38º.**

questions.question: Rahul spends 70% of his income. His income increased by 15% and his expenditure increased by 7.5%. What is the percentage increase in his savings?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume Income = 100, Expenditure = 70, and Savings = 30.

Total Increase in Income = 15% of 100 = 15

Increase in Expenditure = 7.5% of 70 = 5.25

Increase in Savings = 15 − 5.25 = 9.75

Percentage Increase in Savings = (9.75 ÷ 30) × 100 = 32.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 32.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Expenditure = 70% of Income

Increase in Income = 15%

Increase in Expenditure = 7.5%

**Formula Used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

Percentage Increase = (Change ÷ Initial Value) × 100

 
 Income = 100
 
• 
 Exp (70)
 Sav (30)
 

 Inc +15% → 115
 Exp +7.5% → 75.25
 Sav → 39.75

**Calculations:**

Let initial Income = 100

⇒ Initial Expenditure = 70

⇒ Initial Savings = 100 − 70 = 30

⇒ New Income = 100 + 15% of 100 = 115

⇒ New Expenditure = 70 + 7.5% of 70

⇒ New Expenditure = 70 + 5.25 = 75.25

⇒ New Savings = 115 − 75.25 = 39.75

⇒ Increase in Savings = 39.75 − 30 = 9.75

⇒ Percentage Increase in Savings = (9.75 ÷ 30) × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase in Savings = 32.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 32.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Relationship

Income is always the sum of Expenditure and Savings. Any change in Income must be balanced by the sum of changes in Expenditure and Savings.

Weighted Average Rule

The percentage change in Income is the weighted average of percentage changes in Expenditure and Savings: %ΔIncome = (%ΔExp × Exp + %ΔSav × Sav) ÷ (Exp + Sav).

Alligation Method

Income problems can be solved using alligation where the ratio of Expenditure to Savings is the inverse of the differences between their percentage changes and the total income percentage change.</p

questions.question: What is the curved surface area of cylinder whose radius is 3cm and height is 14cm? (Take π = (22/7))
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius (r) = 3 cm

Height (h) = 14 cm

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = 2π rh

**Calculation:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × 22/7 × 3 × 14

⇒ CSA = 2 × 22/7 × 3 × 14

⇒ CSA = 2 × 22 × 3 × 2

⇒ CSA = 2 × 22 × 6

⇒ CSA = 264 cm²

**The curved surface area of the cylinder is 264 cm².**

questions.question: How much time (in years) will it take for an amount of ₹4,50,000 to yield ₹45,000 as simple interest at a 5% per annum rate of interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4,50,000

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹45,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 5% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

We need to find T, so we rearrange the formula:

SI = (P × R × T) / 100

⇒ T = (SI × 100) / (P × R)

⇒ T = (45,000 × 100) / (4,50,000 × 5)

⇒ T = 45,00,000 / 22,50,000

⇒ T = 2 years

**It will take 2 years for an amount of ₹4,50,000 to yield ₹45,000 as simple interest at a 5% per annum rate of interest.**
